job.job_description:
We are looking for a seasoned AI Engineer (36 years experience) to lead the development of the intelligent layer for our proprietary platform, Querent
You will architect advanced RAG systems and Agentic workflows to transform messy, unstructured Electronic Health Records (EHR) into life-saving clinical insights
In this role, you will fine-tune both open-source and proprietary LLMs for medical domain specificity, ensuring high precision and reduced hallucinations in critical healthcare contexts
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy production-grade, HIPAA/GDPR-compliant models that directly impact patient outcomes, drug discovery, and clinical trials for million lives
If you are a Python expert with a deep background in LLM, GenAI, NLP, Vector Databases, and MLOps, we invite you to build the future of equitable, data-driven healthcare with us
Key Highlights for Your Outreach:The Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, LangChain/LlamaIndex, Pinecone/Milvus, and Cloud MLOps (AWS/Azure/GCP)
The Impact: Building the world's largest non-Caucasian oncology dataset to solve healthcare disparities
The Innovation: Implementing state-of-the-art Agentic AI and multi-modal clinical data structuring.
Location - Mumbai, Delhi / NCR, Bengaluru , Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Remote
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience, LangGraph workflows, FastAPI backend, AWS deployments, but lacks Azure/GCP and vector DBs.
